title: Build national pregame matrices at configured cutoffs with row/cell lineage, missingness class, fallback, and pinned versions
scope: Atomic BAT-397 matrix construction only. The real population is intentionally empty because BAT-396 admitted no PIT state and supplied no evidence-backed game/cutoff rows. Synthetic cases validate code behavior only and never enter the real matrix.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Each game/cutoff row uses only eligible state, handles home/away/neutral/lower-division/cancellations deterministically, and separates structural/not-known/source/resolution/pipeline missingness.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: No real row was admitted without eligible state. Sixteen deterministic synthetic assertions prove eligible-only selection, future and target-game output rejection, declared eligible fallback, home/away/neutral classification, lower-division flagging, cancelled-row exclusion, five distinct missingness classes, and deterministic row/cell lineage.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: The declared output artifacts/pit/pregame_matrix_manifest.json is produced with deterministic identity, provenance, and validation metadata appropriate to this work.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: Two independent builds produced the same 7,277-byte manifest SHA-256 dbf6a30e1745d969e4f21cf507d7b2a240bfd5f5d36a0c22f9db035d0e9bf3b0. Source, code, external-manifest, row-payload, and cell-lineage identities validate independently.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: The work does not fabricate source availability, empirical results, thresholds, model performance, operational readiness, or completion evidence.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: The real matrix remains zero rows/cells and experimentation-ineligible. No cutoff, target, feature value, label, split, model, forecast, metric, BAS, Aggie Excess, or readiness claim was fabricated; twelve unsafe manifest mutations were rejected.

test_matrix.result: Synthetic replay rejects future and same-target-game output observations while selecting the latest eligible observation and only an independently eligible fallback. The real population has no supported cutoff rows and remains empty.
No hypothesis, target, nonempty feature matrix, split, model, calibrator, prediction, or protected evaluation exists in this matrix-construction unit.
POST-SUBTASK-048 can resolve the repository manifest, external manifest, empty Parquet schemas, exact hashes, and explicit experimentation-ineligible disposition without manual reconstruction.
Pinned prerequisite, implementation, producer, tool, runtime, payload, and content identities plus byte-identical rebuild are recorded.
Independent identity/schema/population validation, 16 synthetic contract assertions, and 12 mutation probes passed with zero findings.

honesty_boundary: BAT-397 implements and validates the deterministic matrix contract; it does not make unsupported historical rows eligible.
It does not establish final national historical completeness, GAP-002 or GAP-003 resolution, an approved training matrix, production model readiness, or protected performance.
It does not claim a trained production champion, A&M specialization lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, calibration, score likelihood, or any scientific result.
